# Architecture Diagram

One file of the architecture store's diagram set at `.mochiko/product/architecture/diagrams/` — one diagram per file, the whole file one entry under its `##` title. Any kind may earn a file — state machine, ER, sequence, flowchart, data flow, deployment — while the spine keeps its own container view and key-flow sequences. Authored per mochiko:authoring-architecture-store; diagram craft and taste per mochiko:patterns-system-design. The skeleton constrains the shape, never the voice.

## Title

The file's one `##` heading names the diagram; nothing sits above it, so the whole file is one entry.

## Diagram

One Mermaid block. While a change is in flight its parts are delta-styled — new · modified · removed — per mochiko:patterns-system-design.

## Caption

One line under the block saying what the reader should see in it.

## Draws

A `**Draws:**` line naming everything the diagram draws: a store element or concern row by its joined ID, a data-model entity by file and heading (`data-model.md § Vault`). The diagram is a view; each target's truth stays where it is cited.

## Lifecycle

A `**Lifecycle:**` field of the file's own, holding one of the store's seven values — `ruled` · `proposed (<key>)` · `in-flight (<key>)` · `modifying (<key>)` · `removing (<key>)` · `built` · `removed` — with one open key at most. The file carries no stale flag: the index's health view is that flag's one home.

## Skeleton

## [The diagram's title]

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    [one diagram — state, ER, sequence, flowchart, data flow or deployment; delta-styled while a change is in flight]
```

[One line: what the reader should see in it.]
